Changed: **Quieter chat.** Mentions and replies no longer drop a banner while you are in the app; the dot on the Chat tab tells you.
**"Live data is paused"** is now two calm lines, and you can swipe it away.
**One reply arrow.** Swiping a message to reply shows one arrow, not two.
**Past first.** After the final race, or in a past season, the schedule opens on Past instead of an empty list.
**Early in a season** the title card shows the leader and the gap until the next round can decide it.
Fixed: **PlanB opens again on iOS 16 and 17.** 3.0.6 closed right after launch on iPhones and iPads that are not on iOS 18 yet. Android was not affected.
**The Live Activity follows the session from the start.** It no longer sits on "Updating…" when PlanB was closed as it appeared on the Lock Screen.
**Live timing on iPad.** Next to the chat it no longer shows "Something went wrong".
**No early champion.** The title fight moves only after a race or a sprint, so a qualifying no longer crowns anyone.
**The race dashboard is never empty.** Position changes and Lap times stayed blank when practice messages were filed under the race, as in Mexico City.
